Parses and runs text-based VM instruction tests, then checks status and register results.

# Purpose
This file implements a test runner for VM instruction tests in `src/flamenco/vm`. It reads text files that use a small grammar to describe one or more test fixtures, builds a VM input state from each fixture, executes a single SBPF instruction plus an `EXIT` instruction, and checks the VM result against the expected status and register values. The parser supports input bytes, register values, instruction fields such as `op`, `dst`, `src`, `off`, and `imm`, plus expected outcomes such as `ok`, `err`, `vfy`, and `vfyub`.

The code also sets up the VM execution context, memory regions, call destinations, and syscall tables needed to run each test. [`main`](<#main>) accepts file paths on the command line, or it runs a default set of instruction test files for SBPF version `0` and `2` when no file is given. The file is an executable test program, not a library, and its main purpose is to validate VM instruction behavior against text-based test cases.
